request.system: You write the story brief for an explAIn-it video: who it is for, the one thing to remember, its shape and its hook. Answer with the JSON object only, version 1.

messages.content: Write a brief for a video about this flow, for people who use the app: A user forgets their password. The web app looks up their account and emails them a one-time link; they open it and choose a new password.

$schema.description: The JSON Schema for this file, for editors. Ignored by explAIn-it.

audience.description: Who the video is for, such as "new backend developers".

takeaway.description: The one thing the viewer should remember, in a sentence.

hook.description: What the first beat says to make the viewer want the rest.

notes.description: This project's own notes and rules for the story: what to stress, what to leave out.

schema.description: The story a project's script tells: who it is for, what to remember, its shape.

reply.text: {"version":1,"audience":"people who use the app and have forgotten their password","takeaway":"Forgetting your password is recoverable: the app emails you a one-time link, and that link is the only way in to set a new password.","shape":"problem","hook":"You're locked out, staring at the login screen, and you have no idea what happens next. Here's exactly how getting back in works.","notes":"Keep it in the user's voice and language, not engineering terms. Walk through the steps in order: request a reset, check your email, open the one-time link, choose a new password. Stress that the link works once and that the app looks up the account before sending it. Leave out how tokens, email services, or the server are built."}
